header_sentences: See Border, also see Canaan (Land of).

contexts.text: By terms familiar to the learned...
Use terms they themselves do not understand.
They stick fast in terms... AC 3348:2. AC 3348:end.
The ideas of thought are terminated (in sensuous things). AC 2553.
The boundary of the Canaanites () = the extension of Knowledges with them. Explained.
Every evil has its own limits... When it transgresses these limits it runs into the penalty of evil. AC 1857:2.
The sea and Jordan were boundaries. AC 1585.
Scientifics are the ultimates in which interior things are terminated in order...
The ultimate things, or boundaries, represented the outward man; the boundaries of Canaan were many, in general the Euphrates and the Jordan, and the sea.
He who has extinguished spiritual ideas by means of the terms and definitions of human philosophy...
The extension (of spiritual and celestial things) is meant by the boundaries of Canaan.
The last boundary of the spiritual is the first of the celestial...
Borders, and round about () = those things which are exterior.
They have got but little beyond terms... And they dispute about terms. Example(s).
The skins are the outermost things of an animal in which its interior things are terminated...
These are the terminations of interior things.
Divine order is not terminated except with man in his bodily things, namely in his gestures, actions, etc.
The Natural is the ultimate of order, for in it all interior things are terminated... AC 4539.
He set it for a pillar () = a holy boundary... Good cannot be terminated in good, but in truth, for truth is the recipient of good. AC 3727. AC 4090.

The reason a pillar = a holy boundary, thus the ultimate of order, is that in most ancient times they placed stones where their boundaries were, which marked off the possessions of one from those of another, and were for a sign and a witness that their boundaries were there... Then they thought from them concerning the ultimate in man, thus concerning the ultimate of order, which is truth in the natural man... Hence the ancients who were after the flood began to regard as holy the stones which had been set up in the boundaries. (See Pillar, and Stone.) AC 4580.
Influx... is terminated in the ultimate...
Celestial and spiritual things are terminated in the Natural. AC 4240.

All the boundaries of Canaan represented that which is last or ultimate, and that which is first; that which is last or ultimate because [the land] ceased there, and that which is first because it began there; for all boundaries are of this nature, being the last things to those who go forth, and the first to those who come in... AC 4255:2.
Such heaps were for a sign... that the boundary was there.
The thoughts (of Spirits) are not terminated in such things as while they were in the body...
All boundaries, as rivers, mountains, and lands, represented those things which were ultimate. References.

Jabbock was a boundary of Canaan. Explained. All the boundaries of that Land were significative of celestial and spiritual things of the Lord's Kingdom, according to distance and situation. References. AC 4313.
The Holy in which interior things are terminated. Signified.
(Necessity of using these terms.)
The terms Aristotle invented...
They who want to think from terms...
There are outermost truths to which interior truths are determined, and in which they are terminated.
Celestial things are terminated in spiritual things, and spiritual things in natural things.
Nature is that in which the things of the Spiritual World are terminated. AC 10728.
They have immersed their thoughts in such things as are of the world, that is, in terms and distinctions from them, thus in sensuous things...
The Divine... cannot be terminated in evils and falsities, as is the case with man...

Perforated () = without termination anywhere in the middle. Explained... The interiors are distinct in degrees, and are terminated in each degree, and through the termination are separated from the lower degree... It is necessary that all the degrees be well terminated, and thus by means of terminations be distinct from each other. Explained.
Consequence of the voluntary things not being terminated anywhere in the middle.

Whether there are terminations, and thus planes, may be known in this way... With those who have perceptions of good and truth, there are terminations from the first degree to the last, for such perceptions are impossible without terminations of all the degrees... With those who have conscience, there are also terminations, but from the second degree, or from the third to the ultimate. Explained... Conscience itself is the interior plane in which the influx of Divine good is terminated... With those who have no conscience... the terminations are in the delights of self. Enumerated.

It is chiefly in the other life that it is recognized whether the voluntary things have been terminated with a man, or not terminated. Explained... All those with whom the interior voluntary things have been terminated, are elevated into Heaven... but all those with whom the interior voluntary things have not been terminated, betake themselves into Hell, for the Divine flows through and is turned into what is infernal...
Voluntary things are said to be perforated, or not terminated, when there is no affection of good and truth, or of what is just and fair... The affections are what terminate and close.

From boundary to boundary. Signified, Explained... The reason the river = a boundary, is that the great rivers, Euphrates, Jordan, and Nile, and above all, the sea, were the ultimate boundaries of Canaan. AC 5205.
That falsities stood in the boundaries where truths were, Signified, Explained.
That truths are extirpated from the Natural by means of falsities in the boundaries, Signified, Explained.
The Spiritual World is terminated in man's Natural...
The Natural is the plane in which influx is terminated... AC 10208:end, References.
The plane in which interior things are terminated is the Natural...
Evil and falsity grow there according to the capacity of receiving them which he had acquired in the world, but he is not allowed to overstep the acquired limits.
(No stops, in the Hebrew.)
The ideas of interior thought... are terminated in material things, and where they are terminated there they appear to be.
If (truths and evils) cannot be separated, they are cast out to the boundaries.
The locust in thy boundary () = falsity in the outermost things.
The Hells cannot force their way up further than those who are in the last boundaries of Heaven. Explained.
In all thy border () = wherever truth from good extends itself. Border = the extension of truth from good, for all truth has its own extension... and therefore has its boundaries...
Two statues at the boundary of the universe.
They who receive little are in the boundaries of Heaven...

They ate manna until their coming to the boundary of the Land of Canaan () = that they had the appropriation of good from truth until they came to the region of Heaven... The boundary of the Land of Canaan = the entrance to Heaven, or the region where Heaven begins.
They had made wisdom to consist... chiefly in philosophical terms... In the other life they have but little perception, for they see only in terms, and from terms... AC 8631.
Thou shalt set bounds for the people round about () = extension into Heaven no further than to the spiritual spheres of good. Explained. AC 8837.
Thou shalt set thy boundary from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines () = extension from scientific truths to the interior truths of faith. Explained.
In this, interior things are terminated and come to rest...
Terminations in Heaven, Signified, Explained.
The ends () = the outermost things.
Thou shalt set upon the breastplate chains at the ends () = the conjunction of the whole of Heaven in the outermost things.
I will make thy border spread out () = the multiplication and extension of truth from good.
[Swedenborg footnote 1.]. Every degree is terminated. References.
The simpler angels are in the boundaries. HH 52. HH 275.
In the world are the ultimate effects in which everyone's affection is to be terminated...
Without use, love and wisdom have no boundary, or end.

They are in some higher Heaven at its boundaries, where they are as it were in the light of evening; for in every Society the light decreases from the middle to the boundaries... Those are in the boundaries who are in few truths.
With such persons, (idiots, etc.) the Rational cannot be elevated; for the life... with these has not the boundaries in which it ceases so disposed that...
They are driven into deserts, or caverns, which are in the last boundaries of the so-called Christian world.
Philosophy consists of mere terms. (See Philosophy.)
(On the use and abuse of philosophical terms.)
In the borders () = in the natural man, for in the things which are there spiritual things are terminated.
The border () = all these things.
Border () = the ultimate in which interior things cease and in which they are all together.
(On the boundaries of the Spiritual World.)

I will set thy boundary at the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert even to the river (). The boundaries of Canaan = the ultimates of the Church, which are scientific truths, Knowledges of truth and good from the Word, and rational things. Explained. AE 518:18.
The border (of Egypt) () = scientific truth.
The life of every man is from his works, because affection... and thought... are terminated in them, and so come forth; and unless these are terminated they perish...
